items.summary: The page puts core contributors at 30% of ENA, locked on a one-year cliff at which 25% unlocks, then vesting monthly over three years, with schedules starting at the March 5, 2024 TGE. So 30% × 75% ÷ 36 = 0.625% of supply per month from April 2025 to March 2028. The page doesn't name the day of the month. The page gives investors the same terms as core contributors (one-year 25% cliff, then three years of monthly vesting). Their share of supply wasn't confirmed on the page, so no amount is shown.

The page gives investors the same terms as core contributors (one-year 25% cliff, then three years of monthly vesting). Their share of supply wasn't confirmed on the page, so no amount is shown.
items.sizeText: about $10.8M at today’s price · 0.69% of circulating supply · 0.039 days of trading volume

items.title: MORPHO: Founders (15.2% of supply): vesting ends; Strategic partners, cohort 3: vesting ends
items.summary: The docs say all co-founders relocked to a two-year linear vest after a one-year lockup from the earlier of the transferability date (November 21, 2024) or May 17, 2025. The whitepaper gives the same 12-month cliff (November 21, 2025) and full vesting by November 21, 2027 in one passage, though another passage says May 2028. The docs list this cohort at 6.7%, on a two-year linear vest after a one-year lockup from November 21, 2024. The whitepaper puts the round at 6.23%. The two official figures disagree, so no amount is shown.

headlines.summary: A standing setting converts future incoming wires into stablecoins. Coinbase is also advertising a variable 3.75% APY reward for Coinbase One members.

headlines.summary: Four Democratic senators are raising concerns about the Securities and Exchange Commission's newly unveiled innovation exemption.

headlines.title: Coinbase and Broadridge propose standard for tokenized stock disclosures
headlines.summary: The proposed standard aims to connect tokenized stockholders with corporate disclosures and voting materials across digital wallets, but would not create shareholder rights.

headlines.summary: Standard Chartered said Japan's bond tokenization plans could help the tokenized RWA market reach its $2 trillion forecast by 2028.

headlines.summary: The Solana trading platform unveiled a permissioned lending market, identity passport and issuer liquidity services at Breakpoint.

headlines.summary: The decentralized exchange blamed a leaked trading API key and said its smart contracts were unaffected, while investigators traced funds to Hyperliquid.

headlines.summary: DeFi Development added 9,482 SOL last week, lifting its Solana treasury to about 2.62 million tokens in its 10th straight week of growth.

headlines.title: Brazil's central bank faces backlash over stablecoin money laundering remarks
headlines.summary: A central bank official reportedly said legitimate funds become tainted when moved into stablecoins, comparing the market to the informal "dólar-cabo" system.

headlines.title: Safe Wallet Drained of $6.4 Million via Roles Module
headlines.summary: An Ethereum transaction shows USDC and syrupUSDC leaving one wallet. An analyst traced the drain to a gap in its delegated trading permissions.

headlines.summary: Zelle plans to use Solana for its ZelleUSD stablecoin and international payments, with confidential transfers designed to hide payment amounts.

headlines.title: Coinbase, Broadridge Propose Onchain Rights Standard
headlines.summary: The proposed framework would link tokenized shares to corporate notices. Voting remains a next step, and the canonical data schema is still pending.

headlines.title: Ledger Brings Clear Signing to Solana DeFi Transactions
headlines.summary: Jupiter swaps can show assets and amounts on the signer before approval, but unsupported transactions still fall back to blind signing.

headlines.title: HKMA, Swift Explore Cross-Border Tokenized Payments
headlines.summary: Bank of China (Hong Kong), HSBC and Standard Chartered are involved in exploring a connection between Project Ensemble and Swift’s shared ledger.

headlines.summary: Matched price data show ENA also lost 37% over four weeks, while USDe circulation remained above its level at the start of that period.

headlines.title: Bitso's Mexican Peso Stablecoin MXNB Heads to Solana
headlines.summary: Issuer Juno lists a Solana token address as Bitso pitches peso credit. MXNB's latest issuer snapshot reported 77.7 million tokens in circulation.

headlines.title: Kava Speeds HARD Lend Shutdown After 53.9M KAVA Theft
headlines.summary: Kava plans a seven-day governance vote to end new lending and borrowing, while depositors await details on how remaining positions will be handled.

headlines.title: DBS, JPMorgan launch instant tokenized deposit transfers between US and Singapore
headlines.summary: Ant International is their first client, deploying the service for treasury and liquidity management across its entities in both markets.

headlines.title: DBS, JPMorgan’s Kinexys launch 24/7 transfers of tokenized deposits
headlines.summary: Ant International is the first customer to use the service, which lets clients transfer US dollar deposits between Singapore and the US.

headlines.title: JPMorgan and DBS let clients move dollars across borders on weekends
headlines.summary: DBS and JPMorgan have connected their blockchain-based deposit networks, letting approved clients move tokenized U.S. dollars between Singapore and the U.S. at any time, including weekends.

headlines.title: Spark TVL Falls 15.3% in a Week to a 30-Day Low
headlines.summary: The dollar value of assets tracked by DefiLlama fell to $5.70 billion. The change is not a measure of withdrawals or lost lending capacity.

headlines.title: Changing of Lagarde: How the candidates to be next ECB president view bitcoin, stablecoins and CBDCs
headlines.summary: ECB President Christine Lagarde will step down from her post in February 2027, and none of the primary candidates to succeed her are great fans of crypto.

headlines.title: RWA protocol stUSDT winds down 3 years after $2.3B TVL peak
headlines.summary: The stUSDT team did not disclose a reason for winding down the RWA protocol but assured holders that all underlying assets remain fully backed.

headlines.title: Aave Executive Reports $39 Million in Liquidations
headlines.summary: Luigi D'Onorio DeMeo reported about $18 million for one day and $21 million so far the next.

headlines.summary: XRP tanked to its lowest level since November 2024 as ETF outflows and shrinking stablecoin supply add to pressure on crypto markets.

headlines.summary: Canton Network is a privacy-enabled blockchain built for banks and tokenized assets. Here's how it works and what Canton Coin (CC) does.

headlines.summary: The planned Solana integration would fund lender returns with covered calls, leaving borrowers exposed to forgone gains and liquidation.
